attackers_goals: An attacker may want to lock out an organization and retain sole access.
description: An Azure AD identity removed multiple administrators from their roles.
investigative_actions: Check if the identity performing the actions was authorized to perform them. Check what roles the users were removed from. Check whether the identity is a newly added admin. Check if the identity is operating in its usual manner (location, time, operations)* Check if the identity performed additional operations in the cloud environment that might be malicious.
name: Multiple Azure AD admin role removals
